items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Frank Brown used to--used to be up here years ago and he used to write for Buddy Johnson Band, Erskine Hawkins Band and a hell of a big band arranger.

ctx.x: Hmmm. Yeah, I remember the name--Frank Brown.
